preconditions.description: The length of the strings s and t is between 1 and 10^6.
The lengths of s and t are equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s consists only of '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t consists only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if s != t else min_operations
postconditions.description: If s cannot be converted to t, return -1. Otherwise, return the minimum number of operations required.
